abstract: In auction markets that are prone to market power issues, suppliers can extract excessive supplier surplus by excessively high bid pricing. So-called automated mitigation procedures (AMP) can identify and preemptively mitigate suspected market power abuse in real-time. Under certain conditions, they enforce temporary price caps and penalize bids that exceed the cap. We define this as price-cap-and-penalty regulation. Despite their widespread application in US electricity markets, there is scarce evidence on how firms strategically react to such regulatory interventions. We assess the causal impact of AMP on supply bids, using 2019 data from US electricity markets. We employ a regression discontinuity design, which exploits the fact that the price cap with penalty is only activated when structural market power indices exceed a certain cutoff. In each market, 30%–40% of the analyzed bidders strategically decrease their maximum bid prices by 4-10 $/MWh to avoid the penalty. However, a market-wide impact is not statistically detectable, suggesting heterogeneity in firm response and lax mitigation thresholds. Using a merit-order simulation, we estimate the short-term welfare impact of more stringent thresholds to reach the order of magnitude of 8 to 9 million dollars of increased buyer surplus, while maintaining reasonable intervention rates. An additional $4 million in consumer welfare gains are possible if bidders respond more strongly to tighter regulation. Our results motivate the empirical calibration of thresholds to improve the efficiency of price-cap-and-penalty regulation.
title: Strategic bid response under automated market power mitigation in electricity markets
title_zh: 电力市场中自动市场力缓解下的策略性投标响应

abstract: Forecasting commodity prices is important for investment and risk management, yet developing a unified framework that performs well across commodities remains challenging. Existing studies show that forecast combination methods can be effective in high-dimensional settings, but they focus on one-step combinations and provide limited guidance on balancing the resulting forecast against a stable benchmark. Building on this insight, we introduce an iterated combination framework that adaptively combines traditional forecast combinations with a naive no-change benchmark forecast, integrating macroeconomic, market-level, and technical signals. Using data on eight commodities from 1982 to 2023, we find that the iterated approach consistently outperforms benchmark forecasts, traditional combination methods, and advanced single-model techniques, and delivers meaningful economic gains for investors. We further provide evidence that its superior performance is linked to better capturing energy-market supply–demand dynamics. These findings have important implications for asset allocation and risk management in commodity markets.
title: Raising the bar in commodity price forecasting: Evidence from iterated forecast combinations
title_zh: 提高大宗商品价格预测的标准：来自迭代预测组合的证据

abstract: We evaluate the First-Generation Graduate Scholarship scheme implemented in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu, which waives tuition fees for first-generation college students in technical education. The scheme represents a large-scale non-identity-based affirmative action policy in higher education, using first-generation status as the basis for eligibility. Using household survey data in difference-in-differences (DiD) and synthetic DiD frameworks, we find substantial improvements in enrollment, stream choice, and graduation in technical courses, with downstream effects on regular employment, occupational choices, and household welfare. Male students gained more than female students. The scheme also increased reliance on education loans to cover residual costs. The findings suggest that policies based on first-generation status can promote intergenerational mobility by expanding higher education access and improving labour market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了印度泰米尔纳德邦实施的第一代研究生奖学金计划，该计划免除了技术教育中第一代大学生的学费。该计划代表了一项大规模的非身份认同为基础的平权行动政策，在高等教育中，以第一代身份作为资格依据。利用家庭调查数据，在双重差分（DiD）和合成双重差分框架下，我们发现技术课程的入学率、专业选择和毕业情况有了显著改善，并对正规就业、职业选择和家庭福利产生了下游影响。男性学生比女性学生获益更多。该计划还增加了对教育贷款的依赖，以覆盖剩余成本。研究结果表明，基于第一代身份的政策可以通过扩大高等教育入学机会和改善劳动力市场结果来促进代际流动性。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: First-generation status as a criterion for affirmative action: Education and labour market effects of a tuition waiver in India
title_zh: 第一代身份作为平权行动的标准：印度学费减免的教育与劳动力市场效应

abstract: This study examines the causal effect of financial knowledge on stock pricing efficiency. Leveraging a specially designed investor education website, we conduct a field experiment, sharing insights on the pricing of accounting accruals with investors across China and the US on social media. We find that the treatment stocks experience a reduction in accrual mispricing relative to the control stocks. This effect is particularly pronounced when knowledge that enhances the conceptual understanding of accruals is paired with knowledge that aids in the quantitative application of accruals. Furthermore, the treatment effect is strengthened among stocks with investors who engage more deeply with the educational content yet possess lower financial sophistication.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融知识对股票定价效率的因果效应。借助一个专门设计的投资者教育网站，我们开展了一项实地实验，通过社交媒体向中国及美国的投资者分享关于会计应计项目定价的见解。研究发现，相较于对照组股票，处理组股票的应计项目错误定价有所减少。当增强对应计项目概念理解的知识与辅助应计项目量化应用的知识相结合时，这一效应尤为显著。此外，在处理组中，那些更深入参与教育内容但金融素养较低的投资者所持有的股票，其处理效应更为增强。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Knowledge is power: A field experiment in the Chinese and US stock markets
title_zh: 知识即力量：中美股市的实地实验

abstract: This paper studies the impact of health on structural transformation and aggregate productivity in low-income economies through its effects on the gender-based division of labor across sectors. I develop a two-sector general equilibrium model in which returns to health are higher for men than for women in agriculture, implying that health improvements reallocate female labor toward nonagriculture. The model is calibrated to African economies. Quantitative results show that health improvements substantially reduce the agricultural employment share—particularly among women—and increase aggregate labor productivity. Over one-third of the productivity gains can be attributed to the gender-based division of labor. Policy experiments indicate that health subsidies are more effective than education subsidies in reducing women’s agricultural employment relative to men’s and in improving aggregate productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了健康状况如何通过影响性别分工在不同部门间的分布，进而对低收入经济体的结构转型和总体生产率产生影响。我构建了一个两部门一般均衡模型，在该模型中，农业部门中男性健康回报高于女性，这意味着健康改善会促使女性劳动力向非农业部门转移。模型针对非洲经济体进行了校准。定量结果显示，健康改善显著降低了农业就业份额——尤其是女性农业就业份额——并提高了总体劳动生产率。超过三分之一的生产率提升可归因于基于性别的劳动分工。政策实验表明，相较于教育补贴，健康补贴在减少女性相对于男性的农业就业、提升总体生产率和福利方面更为有效。
title: Health, Gender Division of Labor, and Productivity
title_zh: 健康、性别分工与生产率

abstract: Mutual fund managers' skills, measured by risk-adjusted alphas, are predictable using fund characteristics identified by machine learning (e.g., Kaniel et al., 2023, JFE; DeMiguel et al., 2023, JFE). However, alpha's predictive power varies across funds and periods, with most funds exhibiting negligible alphas. To model this heterogeneous predictability, this paper introduces Sparse Clustering GMM, a nonparametric approach for uncovering latent fund groups. SCGMM clusters funds using estimated alphas and identifies group-specific parameters tied to market predictors. The method accounts for heterogeneity in cross-sectional grouping and time-varying mechanisms across predictors, without requiring prior cluster information or time-varying specifications. We establish consistency for group recovery and time-varying parameter estimation. Empirically, using monthly U.S. mutual fund data, we find that predictable alpha is concentrated in a small subset of funds, with the majority of funds exhibiting near-zero, weakly predictable alphas. The skilled clusters also exhibit lower benchmark R^2, moderate expense ratios, and longer manager tenure.
abstract_zh: 共同基金经理的技能，以风险调整后的阿尔法衡量，可通过机器学习识别的基金特征进行预测（例如，Kaniel等，2023，JFE；DeMiguel等，2023，JFE）。然而，阿尔法的预测能力在不同基金和时期之间存在差异，大多数基金的阿尔法接近于零。为建模这种异质性预测，本文引入了稀疏聚类GMM，一种用于识别潜在基金组的非参数方法。SCGMM利用估计的阿尔法对基金进行聚类，并识别与市场预测因子相关的组特定参数。该方法考虑了横截面分组中的异质性以及预测因子间随时间变化的机制，无需先验聚类信息或时变设定。我们建立了组恢复和时变参数估计的一致性。实证上，利用美国月度共同基金数据，我们发现可预测的阿尔法集中于一小部分基金，而大多数基金表现出接近零、弱可预测的阿尔法。技能较高的聚类还表现出较低的基准R²、适中的费用比率和更长的经理任期。
title: Heterogeneous predictability on mutual fund alphas: A sparse clustering GMM approach
title_zh: 共同基金阿尔法的异质性可预测性：一种稀疏聚类GMM方法

abstract: This paper develops a test for coefficient variability in spatial regressions. The test is designed to have good power for a wide range of persistent patterns of coefficient variation, be applicable in a wide range of spatial designs, and accommodate spatial correlation in regressors and regression errors. The test approximates the locally best invariant test for coefficient stability in a Gaussian regression model with martingale-like coefficient variation under the alternative, and is thus a spatial generalization of the Nyblom (1989) test of coefficient stability in time series regressions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种针对空间回归中系数变异性的检验方法。该检验旨在对广泛的持续性系数变化模式具有良好的检验功效，适用于多种空间设计，并能容纳回归因子及回归误差中的空间相关性。此检验近似于高斯回归模型中系数稳定性检验的局部最优不变检验，其中备择假设下系数变化具有类鞅性质，因此它是Nyblom（1989）时间序列回归系数稳定性检验的空间推广。
title: Testing coefficient stability in spatial regression
title_zh: 检验空间回归中的系数稳定性

abstract: Circular economy solutions within the food system have prioritized prevention. Prevention policies can be formulated as carrots, e.g., waste abatement subsidies, or sticks, e.g., waste disposal taxes, and applied at one or more segments along the food supply chain. We develop a general equilibrium model of the U.S. Midwest that endogenizes food waste decisions and policy responses at key supply chain links. Existing models of circular food systems often fail to endogenize the amount of food waste and seldom apply multiple policies at different food supply chain stages. Our results identify how carrots and sticks differ across targeted supply chain stages. Waste abatement subsidies primarily result in a decrease in waste rates, while a food waste tax leads consumers to adjust both food purchases and waste rates equally. Subsidizing waste abatement can be five times more effective than a food waste tax in reducing food waste, despite both yielding comparable emissions reductions. 88% of emissions reduction caused by a tax derives from reduced food demand (and thus supply). With abatement subsidies, 28% of emissions reduction derives from decreased landfill deposits and 64% from reduced food supply. Our results also suggest that policies aimed at consumers can have four times greater impacts than those applied upstream. Lastly, as their combinations typically generate additive effects, carrots and sticks can complement one another, further informing an optimal policy suite that reduces food waste, while mitigating unintended consequences (e.g., rebound effects or consumption reduction).
abstract_zh: 食品系统内的循环经济解决方案优先考虑了预防措施。预防政策可设计为激励手段，如废弃物减排补贴，或约束手段，如废弃物处理税，并可在食品供应链的一个或多个环节实施。我们构建了一个美国中西部地区的可计算一般均衡模型，该模型内生了关键供应链环节中的食物浪费决策及政策响应。现有的循环食品系统模型往往未能内生化食物浪费量，且很少在食品供应链的不同阶段同时应用多种政策。我们的研究结果揭示了激励与约束手段在不同目标供应链环节上的差异效应。废弃物减排补贴主要导致浪费率下降，而食物浪费税则促使消费者同时调整食品购买量和浪费率。在减少食物浪费方面，补贴废弃物减排的效果可能是食物浪费税的五倍，尽管两者在减排方面产生的效果相当。税收带来的排放减少中，88%源于食品需求（进而供应）的下降。而在补贴废弃物减排的情况下，排放减少的28%归因于垃圾填埋场沉积物的减少，64%则源于食品供应的缩减。我们的结果还表明，针对消费者的政策其影响可能是针对上游环节政策的四倍。最后，由于政策组合通常产生叠加效应，激励与约束手段可以相辅相成，为优化政策组合提供进一步指导，以在减少食物浪费的同时，缓解意外后果（如反弹效应或消费减少）。
title: Comparing carrots and sticks to create a more circular food system
title_zh: 比较胡萝卜与大棒政策以构建更循环的食品体系

abstract: Land degradation and climate change remain pressing challenges to agricultural development in Ethiopia, where rural farm households rely heavily on rainfed agriculture amid mounting ecological stress and climate risks. Although Sustainable Land Management (SLM) practices are central to mitigating these risks, intervention outcomes are mixed, and most empirical studies rarely consider the recursive and endogenous nature of farmers’ adaptation decisions, failing to distinguish between independent and conditionally interdependent adaptation decisions, leaving a missing link in our understanding of their combined effects. While the standard multivariate probit model accounts for interdependence through correlated error terms, it still overlooks the structural and directional connections among SLM adaptation choices. Recursive specifications explicitly capture how upstream adaptation conditioned the feasibility and effectiveness of downstream adaptation, incorporating both correlation and causal ordering across SLM domains. Using this framework, the study investigates the determinants and interdependencies among structural, agronomic, and ecosystem-based SLM adaptation strategies, employing nationally representative data and a recursive multivariate probit (RMVP) model. Using 15,839 pooled observations from two waves of the Ethiopian Living Standards Measurement Survey (2018/19 and 2021/22), we modeled the recursive relationships among the three adaptation domains. Results demonstrate that the uptake of structural and agronomic measures significantly enhances ecosystem-based adaptation. In contrast, agronomic adaptation is positively influenced by structural adaptation, revealing strong complementarities among SLM technologies. Other exogenous covariates, such as education level, annual expenditure, food security, landholding, and participation in watershed programs, significantly increase the likelihood of adaptation, whereas market distance and plot remoteness constrain adaptation decisions. Viewing decision-making as a recursive process offers a more realistic depiction of how smallholders integrate multiple adaptation pathways amid complex socioeconomic and ecological constraints. Policies that promote integrated SLM practices are more likely to yield resilient, sustainable, and climate-smart land-use outcomes in Ethiopia.
abstract_zh: 土地退化与气候变化仍是埃塞俄比亚农业发展面临的紧迫挑战，该国农村农户在生态压力与气候风险日益加剧的背景下，高度依赖雨养农业。尽管可持续土地管理（SLM）实践是缓解这些风险的核心手段，但干预效果参差不齐，且多数实证研究很少考虑农户适应决策的递归性与内生性特征，未能区分独立适应决策与条件性相互依赖的适应决策，导致对其综合效应的理解存在缺失环节。标准多元概率比模型虽通过误差项相关性考虑了相互依赖关系，但仍忽视了SLM适应选择之间的结构性与方向性联系。递归设定明确刻画了上游适应如何制约下游适应的可行性与有效性，将SLM各领域间的相关性与因果顺序同时纳入分析。基于这一框架，本研究利用具有全国代表性的数据，采用递归多元概率比（RMVP）模型，考察结构性、农艺性和基于生态系统的SLM适应策略的决定因素及其相互依赖关系。利用埃塞俄比亚生活水平测量调查两轮数据（2018/19和2021/22年度）汇总的15，839个观测值，本研究对三类适应领域之间的递归关系进行了建模。结果表明，结构性措施和农艺措施的采纳显著促进了基于生态系统的适应；而农艺适应受到结构性适应的正向影响，揭示了SLM技术之间存在较强的互补性。其他外生协变量，如教育水平、年支出、粮食安全、土地持有量及参与流域治理项目，均显著提高适应概率，而市场距离和地块偏远程度则制约适应决策。将决策过程视为递归过程，能够更真实地刻画小农户在复杂社会经济与生态约束下如何整合多种适应路径。促进SLM综合实践的政策更有可能在埃塞俄比亚实现具有韧性、可持续和气候智慧型的土地利用结果。
title: Exploring the determinants and recursive influences of land degradation and climate change adaptation technologies in Ethiopia: Evidence from a recursive multivariate probit model
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚土地退化与气候变化适应技术的决定因素及递归影响探究：来自递归多元概率模型的证据

abstract: Communal Reserves were established as a co-management compromise between the Peruvian state and Amazonian indigenous peoples to promote biodiversity conservation and indigenous territorial rights. However, these areas face escalating land grabbing, environmental degradation and violence. This study utilizes archival, spatial, and ethnographic data to analyze the magnitude, drivers, and mechanisms of Land Use and Land Cover Change (LULCC) in El Sira Communal Reserve and its buffer zone. We find that current pressures stem from a longstanding legacy of state-led colonization and agricultural development preceding the reserve’s creation. Our spatial analysis shows that El Sira’s deforestation and agricultural expansion rates are the highest among all Peruvian Communal Reserves and their buffer zones. Finally, our ethnographic action research highlights the role of subnational governments in facilitating LULCC through state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands. Our discussion exposes the limitations of co-managed conservation in the Central Peruvian Amazon, where growth coalitions and a legacy of settler colonization provide the administrative infrastructure necessary to transform protected forests into private assets.
abstract_zh: 社区保护区（Communal Reserves）是秘鲁国家与亚马逊原住民之间为促进生物多样性保护和原住民土地权利而建立的共同管理折中方案。然而，这些区域正面临日益严重的土地侵占、环境退化和暴力问题。本研究利用档案、空间和民族志数据，分析埃尔西拉社区保护区及其缓冲区内土地利用与土地覆盖变化（LULCC）的规模、驱动因素和机制。我们发现，当前的压力源于保护区建立之前长期存在的国家主导的殖民化和农业发展遗留问题。空间分析显示，埃尔西拉地区的森林砍伐和农业扩张率在秘鲁所有社区保护区及其缓冲区中最高。最后，我们的民族志行动研究揭示了地方政府在通过国家支持的原住民土地剥夺促进LULCC中所扮演的角色。我们的讨论揭示了秘鲁中部亚马逊地区共同管理保护的局限性，在那里，增长联盟和定居者殖民化的遗留问题提供了将受保护森林转变为私人资产所需的行政基础设施。
title: When co-managed conservation fails: Environmental degradation and state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands in communal reserves in the Peruvian Amazon
title_zh: 共同管理保护失败之时：秘鲁亚马逊社区保护区中的环境退化与国家支持的原住民土地剥夺

abstract: We study privatization in vertically related markets through the lens of consumer surplus, focusing on the optimality of mixed ownership regimes. We consider a successive monopoly in which both upstream and downstream sectors consist either of profit-maximizing private firms or welfare-maximizing but relatively inefficient public firms. When markups are either very high or very low, mixed regimes are intermediate, ranking neither best nor worst in terms of consumer surplus. In contrast to standard results for symmetric single-stage oligopolies, mixed regimes can maximize consumer surplus in vertical settings when market power is moderate and public firms’ inefficiency relative to private firms differs sufficiently across sectors. In such cases, selection is crucial: consumer surplus is maximized by privatizing only the sector in which public firms are relatively more inefficient. While our primary focus is on consumer surplus and successive monopoly, we also examine welfare and competition. Welfare rankings largely mirror consumer surplus rankings, except that, relative to consumer surplus, the private (public) regime is more likely to rank highest (lowest) under the welfare criterion. Downstream competition expands the parameter range over which mixed ownership maximizes consumer surplus. In the presence of competition in both upstream and downstream sectors, either mixed regime—that is, privatizing either sector alone—can maximize consumer surplus, regardless of the public–private efficiency gap, provided the privatized sector is sufficiently more competitive than the vertically related sector.
abstract_zh: 我们从消费者剩余的视角研究纵向关联市场中的私有化问题，聚焦于混合所有制安排的最优性。我们考虑一个连续垄断模型，其中上游和下游部门均由追求利润最大化的私营企业或追求福利最大化但相对低效的公共企业构成。当加成率极高或极低时，混合所有制处于中间状态，在消费者剩余方面既非最优也非最劣。与对称单阶段寡头市场的标准结论不同，在纵向结构中，当市场势力适中且公共企业相对于私营企业的低效程度在各部门间存在足够差异时，混合所有制能够最大化消费者剩余。在此类情形下，选择至关重要：消费者剩余最大化要求仅对公共企业相对更低效的部门进行私有化。尽管我们的主要关注点是消费者剩余和连续垄断，我们也考察了福利与竞争。福利排序在很大程度上与消费者剩余排序一致，但相对于消费者剩余标准，在福利标准下，私营（公共）所有制更可能排名最高（最低）。下游竞争扩大了混合所有制能够最大化消费者剩余的参数范围。当上游和下游部门均存在竞争时，任一混合所有制——即仅对任一部门进行私有化——都能最大化消费者剩余，无论公私效率差距如何，前提是被私有化的部门相对于纵向关联部门具有足够的竞争性。
title: Consumer surplus and privatization in vertically related markets
title_zh: 垂直相关市场中的消费者剩余与私有化

abstract: Governments increasingly use soft, non-binding trade promotion partnerships alongside, or instead of, binding agreements, but their effects remain unclear. This paper studies the UK’s post-Brexit memoranda of understanding with individual US states. These partnerships promote trade and investment but cannot alter tariffs or establish enforceable market-access commitments. Using a structural gravity model and monthly state level goods trade data, we find no evidence of broad goods trade creation. Aggregate effects are insignificant, and product- and state-level estimates are heterogeneous rather than systematically positive, suggesting MoUs support economic cooperation rather than producing the broad trade effects associated with traditional binding agreements.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益倾向于在具有约束力的协议之外或取而代之，采用软性的、非约束性的贸易促进伙伴关系，但其效果仍不明确。本文研究了英国脱欧后与美国各州签署的谅解备忘录。这些伙伴关系旨在促进贸易与投资，但无法改变关税或确立可执行的市场准入承诺。利用结构引力模型和月度州级商品贸易数据，我们发现没有证据表明存在广泛的商品贸易创造效应。总体影响不显著，且产品和州层面的估计结果呈现异质性而非系统性正向，这表明谅解备忘录支持经济合作，而非产生与传统约束性协议相关的广泛贸易效应。
title: Do non-binding trade promotion partnerships create trade? Evidence from UK-US state memoranda of understanding
title_zh: 非约束性贸易促进伙伴关系能否创造贸易？来自英美州级谅解备忘录的证据

abstract: The canonical prediction of life-cycle models, that individuals smooth consumption over their lifetime, has mostly been tested in developed countries and found little empirical support. We provide a novel developing-country perspective by analyzing patterns of life-cycle consumption, income, and savings rates in India. In contrast to the U.S., Indian households exhibit little growth in nondurable consumption expenditures after adjusting for family size. Surprisingly, this flat adjusted profile coexists with substantial income growth and a sharp rise in the savings/surplus rate over the life cycle. We show that lumpy non-housing durable accumulation is an important use of this life-cycle surplus, helping reconcile high savings rates with flat measured adult-equivalent nondurable consumption. Quantitatively, non-housing durable stock growth accounts for about one-third of accumulated life-cycle surplus by age 45, and an augmented expenditure profile that adds imputed non-housing durable investment flows to nondurables raises adult-equivalent life-cycle growth from 8.4% to 27.9%.
abstract_zh: 生命周期模型的经典预测——个体在一生中平滑消费——主要在发达国家得到检验，但实证支持甚少。我们通过分析印度的生命周期消费、收入及储蓄率模式，提供了一个新颖的发展中国家视角。与美国的状况相反，印度家庭在调整家庭规模后，非耐用品消费支出几乎没有增长。令人惊讶的是，这种平稳的调整后消费曲线与显著的收入增长及生命周期中储蓄/盈余率的急剧上升并存。我们表明，非住房耐用品的大额积累是这一生命周期盈余的重要用途，有助于调和高储蓄率与平稳的成人等价非耐用品消费之间的矛盾。定量分析显示，到45岁时，非住房耐用品存量增长约占累积生命周期盈余的三分之一，而将估算的非住房耐用品投资流加入非耐用品后，扩展的支出曲线使成人等价生命周期增长率从8.4%提升至27.9%。
title: Household consumption and savings over the life cycle: The roles of demographics and durables
title_zh: 生命周期中的家庭消费与储蓄：人口结构与耐用消费品的作用

abstract: This paper studies the impact of child migration on outcomes of elders who stay behind: consumption, economic participation, health, and mental health. Exploiting variation from the preexisting ties between provinces interacted with the time-varying intensity of regional migration deregulation, we find that increased incentives for internal migration in China resulted in more remittances to rural households, boosting consumption and reducing farm work among the elderly who stay behind. The paper also shows improved healthcare utilization and physical health in these non-migrating elderly populations. However, child migration came with a potential downside: the modest decline in the mental well-being of elderly individuals, possibly due to a lack of informal care and companionship from migrated children. These findings show how internal migration impacts the health and economic wellbeing of elderly individuals in developing countries. (JEL I15, J18, O18, P25, P36, R23)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了子女迁移对留守老年人结果的影响：消费、经济参与、健康及心理健康。利用省份间既有联系与区域迁移放松政策时间变化强度的交互变异，我们发现中国内部迁移激励的增加导致农村家庭汇款增多，从而提升了留守老年人的消费并减少了其农业劳动。本文还显示，这些未迁移老年人口的医疗利用和身体健康状况得到改善。然而，子女迁移也带来潜在不利影响：老年人心理健康水平适度下降，可能源于迁移子女提供的非正式照料和陪伴缺失。这些发现揭示了内部迁移如何影响发展中国家老年人的健康与经济福祉。（JEL I15, J18, O18, P25, P36, R23）
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Migration Incentives and Elderly Health: Evidence from the Hukou Reforms in China
title_zh: 迁移激励与老年人健康：来自中国户籍改革的证据

abstract: China’s rapid growth alongside extensive state ownership challenges theories of state-sector inefficiency. This paper identifies a novel micro-level channel: “dual-track in the family,” whereby one spouse’s stable state job enables the other to pursue private entrepreneurship. Using a triple-difference design that exploits the 1993 market reform, we find that spouses of state employees were 9.8 percentage points more likely to become entrepreneurs after the reform. Mechanism evidence suggests that spousal state employment may promote entrepreneurship by insuring the family against risk. The findings reveal how a gradualist, dual-track transition can succeed partly by leveraging state-sector stability to underpin private-sector dynamism.
abstract_zh: 中国经济的快速增长与大规模国有制并存，对国有部门低效率的传统理论构成挑战。本文识别出一个新颖的微观层面渠道：“家庭双轨制”，即一方稳定的国有部门工作使另一方得以投身私营创业。利用1993年市场化改革作为准自然实验，采用三重差分设计，我们发现改革后，国有部门员工的配偶成为企业家的概率高出9.8个百分点。机制证据表明，配偶的国有部门就业可能通过为家庭提供风险保障来促进创业。研究结果揭示了渐进式双轨转型何以部分成功，其关键在于利用国有部门的稳定性支撑私营部门的活力。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于中国1993年市场化改革，使用中国数据，核心制度背景和对象均为中国，明确属于中国研究。
title: Dual-track in the family: How spousal state employment fuels entrepreneurship
title_zh: 家庭中的双轨制：配偶体制内就业如何助推创业

abstract: This paper examines trade-induced restructuring at the extensive margin, using a novel measure of new work—jobs employing new knowledge, skills, and technologies—based on the emergence of new job titles over time. I find that import competition significantly increases the adoption of new work in US manufacturing industries. I further show that offshoring is central to this restructuring process and is accompanied by compositional shifts toward non-production activities. Finally, evidence from local labor market analysis indicates that these adjustments extend beyond within-industry responses and that new work is a critical channel through which trade shocks increase local wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了贸易引致的广泛边际重组，采用一种基于新职业头衔随时间涌现的新颖度量——新工作（即运用新知识、技能和技术的岗位）。我发现进口竞争显著增加了美国制造业行业中新工作的采纳。我进一步表明，离岸外包在这一重组过程中至关重要，并伴随着向非生产活动的构成性转变。最后，来自地方劳动力市场分析的证据表明，这些调整超越了行业内反应，且新工作是贸易冲击加剧地方工资不平等的一个关键渠道。
title: The extensive margin of restructuring: Adoption of new work in a global economy
title_zh: 重组的广延边际：全球经济中新工作的采用

abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of sustainable investment in which emission-based government regulation simultaneously stimulates green investment and creates policy-induced transition risk. A novel market failure emerges: policy uncertainty generates both financial value and pro-social values for emission mitigation, but firms internalize only the financial benefits and therefore underinvest in mitigation, triggering the emission rebound effect. Investor activism can alleviate this distortion and incentivize green investment. Hence, activism reduces the need for aggressive policy intervention. This substitution effect is weakened by advisory costs but strengthened by green innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于可持续投资的动态理论，其中基于排放的政府监管同时刺激绿色投资并产生政策引发的转型风险。一种新颖的市场失灵现象浮现：政策不确定性既为减排带来财务价值，也带来亲社会价值，但企业仅内化财务收益，因此对减排投资不足，引发排放反弹效应。投资者积极主义能够缓解这一扭曲并激励绿色投资。因此，积极主义降低了对激进政策干预的需求。这种替代效应因咨询成本而减弱，但会因绿色创新而增强。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究不确定气候政策与积极投资者对绿色投资的影响，为一般性理论模型，未明确涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者姓名不足以判定为中国研究。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Uncertain Climate Policy and Activist Investing
title_zh: 不确定的气候政策与积极投资者投资

abstract: The fate of the handloom cotton textile industry is one of the most debated topics in the economic history of India. This paper presents novel employment estimates for cotton textile handweaving and spinning in the period 1800–1940. I put together plausible values for labour productivity and combine these with aggregate input usage to generate employment estimates. I then examine a number of related topics: the regional question, the relationship between handloom and power‐loom cloth from the consumer's perspective, the standard of living of handloom weavers, and the impact of technological progress within the handloom industry.
abstract_zh: 手织棉纺织业的命运是印度经济史中争论最为激烈的话题之一。本文提供了1800年至1940年间棉纺织手工织造与纺纱的新颖就业估算。我整合了合理的劳动生产率数值，并将其与总体投入使用情况相结合，以生成就业估算。随后，我探讨了若干相关议题：区域性问题、从消费者视角看手织机与动力织机布料之间的关系、手织机织工的生活水平，以及手织机行业内技术进步的影响。
title: Indian deindustrialization revisited: New data, estimates, and interpretations
title_zh: 印度去工业化再探讨：新数据、估算与解释

abstract: In many countries, a private health system coexists with the public one. However, the latter is increasingly subject to budgetary cuts and no longer able to meet healthcare demand. Within an O L G model in which young agents, beside in capital, invest also in health, we show that access to the public health system is rationed by increasing waiting times, entailing costs in terms of treatment effectiveness and psychological order. Considering a fiscal policy aimed at providing health services and stabilizing public debt-to- G D P , we obtain two equilibrium regimes, the first one emerging for low G D P levels, the other for larger ones. By performing a global analysis, we find a lower globally unstable stationary solution and a higher globally stable one, and waiting times to be counter-cyclical along the transitional path. We also characterize the set of optimal allocations and prove that G D P is increasing in the social discount factor. Finally, we show how to decentralize any optimal allocation by fixing opportunely the debt-to-capital ratio and public healthcare provision.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，私人医疗体系与公共医疗体系并存。然而，后者日益面临预算削减，已无法满足医疗需求。在一个OLG模型中，年轻一代除了投资于资本外，还投资于健康，我们展示了公共医疗体系的准入因等待时间增加而受到限制，这带来了治疗有效性和心理秩序方面的成本。考虑一项旨在提供医疗服务并稳定公共债务与GDP比率的财政政策，我们得到了两种均衡状态，第一种出现在低GDP水平时，第二种则出现在较高GDP水平时。通过进行全局分析，我们发现了一个全局不稳定的较低稳态解和一个全局稳定的较高稳态解，并且等待时间在过渡路径上呈逆周期特征。我们还刻画了最优配置的集合，并证明了GDP随社会贴现因子增加而增加。最后，我们展示了如何通过适当设定债务资本比率和公共医疗供给来分散任何最优配置。
title: Should I wait or should I pay? The dynamics of private and public healthcare
title_zh: 我应该等待还是支付？私人与公共医疗的动态

abstract: This paper studies the long-run impacts of diasporas on local economic development. We do so in the context of one of the most economically influential diasporas: the ethnic Chinese in Southeast Asia. Our instrumental variables strategy exploits 15th-century landing sites on Java that shaped subsequent Chinese settlement but lost maritime access due to 17th-century silting. We find that a 1p.p. higher Chinese share in 1930 leads to 9.4% higher household consumption and 26% higher population today. These effects attenuate sharply during the 1997-1998 crisis, then recover. We find strong effects on firm sales driven by improved financing through local private networks but not through exports. We provide suggestive evidence for the key role of historical ethnic-trading networks within Java. Our findings suggest that despite their small size, ethnic minorities with durable complementarities can play an out-sized, positive role in local economic development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了海外移民对地方经济发展的长期影响。我们以东南亚的华裔族群为背景，这是最具经济影响力的移民群体之一。我们的工具变量策略利用了15世纪爪哇岛的登陆点，这些登陆点塑造了后续华人定居格局，但因17世纪泥沙淤积而失去了海上通道。我们发现，1930年华裔比例每提高1个百分点，当今家庭消费增加9.4%，人口增加26%。这些影响在1997-1998年危机期间急剧减弱，随后恢复。我们发现，通过本地私人网络改善融资对企业销售有显著影响，但出口渠道并无此效应。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明爪哇岛内历史族裔贸易网络的关键作用。我们的研究结果表明，尽管少数族裔规模较小，但具有持久互补性的族裔群体能在地方经济发展中发挥超乎比例的积极作用。

title: Communities of Commerce: The Legacy of Chinese Immigration on Java
title_zh: 商业社群：华人移民爪哇的遗产

abstract: Accounting for multiple responses to weather shocks drastically changes policy implications for adaptation to increasingly variable weather. Kenyan households react to temperature anomalies by sending migrants, by transiting to less climate-sensitive occupations, and by changing livestock species. Evidence suggests these are short-term adjustments, which respond significantly to common interventions. Randomised income transfers cushion consumption losses and decrease adaptation pressure, such as migration. Better infrastructure, instead, eases occupational transitions, reducing alternative adjustments, including migration and livestock composition. A model of joint migration, occupation, and livestock choices reveals long-term effects of these short-term shocks. Transitions to non-agriculture first act as a substitute for migration and subsequently as a stepping stone for later migration.
abstract_zh: 考虑对天气冲击的多重反应，会极大地改变针对日益多变气候的适应政策含义。肯尼亚家庭通过迁移移民、转向对气候敏感度较低的职业以及改变牲畜种类来应对温度异常。证据表明，这些是短期调整，且对常见干预措施反应显著。随机收入转移缓解了消费损失，并降低了适应压力，如迁移。相反，更好的基础设施则促进了职业转换，减少了包括迁移和牲畜构成在内的其他调整方式。一个联合迁移、职业和牲畜选择的模型揭示了这些短期冲击的长期效应。向非农业的转变起初作为迁移的替代，随后成为后续迁移的跳板。
title: Coping with weather shocks
title_zh: 应对天气冲击：DP21830

abstract: I show that falling world agricultural prices increased the likelihood of civil war onset during 1957–2007, especially in Sub-Saharan Africa. A one-standard-deviation price decline raised the likelihood of onset by around 30 percent in the global sample of 118 countries and by around 45 percent in Sub-Saharan Africa, relative to average onset rates of around 2 percent per year. I reconcile these findings with earlier mixed results by showing that the estimated effect depends on how country-specific price indices are constructed. Price indices that isolate changes in world commodity prices yield statistically significant effects, whereas indices conflating price changes with changes in countries’ exports do not. The effect of world prices on civil war onset operated through agricultural producers rather than food consumers. Estimates are essentially unchanged when I control for consumer food-price shocks, and effects are substantially larger among countries whose agricultural exports consist mainly of cash crops. This points to an opportunity-cost channel whereby falling prices depress producer incomes and lower the opportunity cost of joining armed conflict. Export data for low- and middle-income countries are often measured with error. I develop an analysis of measurement error in year-by-year export shares and show that period-average export shares permit consistent estimation.
abstract_zh: 我证明，1957年至2007年间，世界农产品价格下跌增加了内战爆发的可能性，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。在包含118个国家的全球样本中，价格一个标准差的下滑使爆发可能性相对于每年约2%的平均爆发率上升了约30%；而在撒哈拉以南非洲，这一增幅约为45%。我将这些发现与此前混杂的结果相调和，表明估计效应取决于国家特定价格指数的构建方式。仅隔离世界商品价格变动的指数产生了统计上显著的影响，而将价格变动与国家出口变动混为一谈的指数则不然。世界价格对内战爆发的影响是通过农业生产者而非食品消费者传导的。当我控制消费者食品价格冲击时，估计结果基本不变，且在以经济作物为主要农业出口的国家中，效应显著更大。这指向一种机会成本渠道，即价格下跌压低生产者收入，降低了加入武装冲突的机会成本。低收入和中等收入国家的出口数据常存在测量误差。我开发了一种针对逐年出口份额测量误差的分析方法，并表明期间平均出口份额能够实现一致估计。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为全球118个国家及撒哈拉以南非洲，数据与制度背景均非中国，核心应用不涉及中国、中国企业或中国地区。
title: World Agricultural Prices and the Onset of Civil War
title_zh: 世界农产品价格与内战爆发

abstract: Elites maintain disproportionate political power even in formally inclusive political systems, yet the institutions through which they coordinate and reproduce this advantage remain poorly understood. We study membership in the Buenos Aires Jockey Club---Argentina's most prominent elite social club---exploiting staggered variation in family entry. Using difference-in-differences techniques, we find that Jockey Club membership increased the probability of holding legislative office by approximately four percentage points---more than twice the control-group mean. Consistent with a network-based mechanism, membership also increased families' centrality in elite marriage networks---a resource that can facilitate political success through access to party nominations and voter mobilization. This electoral advantage declines substantially after the 1912 Sáenz Peña democratizing reforms, suggesting that the political returns to club membership are conditional on institutional contexts that make elite network connections valuable. Our findings shed light on how elite social institutions reproduce political inequality where personal connections are essential for accessing political office.
abstract_zh: 精英即使在形式上包容的政治体系中，也维持着不成比例的政治权力，然而，他们协调并再生产这一优势的制度机制仍鲜为人知。我们研究了布宜诺斯艾利斯赛马俱乐部——阿根廷最显赫的精英社交俱乐部——的会员资格，利用家族入会时间的交错变化进行实证分析。采用双重差分方法，我们发现赛马俱乐部会员资格使担任立法职务的概率提高了约四个百分点，这一增幅超过对照组均值的两倍。与基于网络的机制相一致，会员资格还增强了家族在精英婚姻网络中的中心性——这一资源可通过获取政党提名和选民动员来促进政治成功。这一选举优势在1912年萨恩斯·佩尼亚民主化改革后显著减弱，表明俱乐部会员资格的政治回报取决于使精英网络联系具有价值的制度环境。我们的研究揭示了精英社会制度如何在个人关系对获取政治职位至关重要的条件下再生产政治不平等。
title: Social Clubs and Political Office
title_zh: 社交俱乐部与政治职务

abstract: This study examines the income loss following forced CEO turnovers using income data from the official records at the Danish Tax Authority. We find that dismissed CEOs’ personal income is 40% lower in the five years following forced turnovers. The decline is driven by labor market outcomes: labor and entrepreneurial incomes decline, while other sources of income increase. We find larger declines in income for executives with poor performance during their tenures, consistent with the executive labor market being the main channel for the lower income. Overall, the findings suggest that executives face significant personal costs from forced turnovers.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用丹麦税务局官方记录的收入数据，考察了强制CEO更替后的收入损失。我们发现，被解雇CEO在强制更替后五年内的个人收入降低了40%。这一下降主要由劳动力市场结果驱动：劳动收入和创业收入减少，而其他收入来源增加。我们发现，任期内表现不佳的高管收入下降幅度更大，这与高管劳动力市场是收入降低的主要渠道相一致。总体而言，研究结果表明，高管因强制更替而面临显著的个人成本。
title: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers
title_zh: 高管更替的个人成本

abstract: Predictions of the effects of AI on the economy and society tend to focus on productivity growth, job losses, and shifts in the distribution of income. This column examines various potential scenarios for the macroeconomic effects of AI, using Congressional Budget Office projections to estimate their effects on the US federal budget, and discusses their implications for US fiscal policy. The conclusions show that the fiscal consequences of AI will depend not only on how much it raises national income, but also on who receives that income and how policymakers respond.
abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对经济和社会影响的预测，通常聚焦于生产率增长、就业损失以及收入分配的变化。本文利用国会预算办公室的预测，考察了人工智能对宏观经济影响的各种潜在情景，以估算其对美国联邦预算的影响，并探讨了这些影响对美国财政政策的启示。结论表明，人工智能的财政后果不仅取决于其提高国民收入的程度，还取决于谁获得这些收入以及政策制定者如何应对。
authors: Karen Dynan, Douglas Elmendorf, Louise Sheiner
title: How the rise of AI matters for fiscal policy
title_zh: 人工智能崛起对财政政策的影响

abstract: Employment polarisation – the decline of middle-skill routine occupations relative to both ends of the skill distribution – is usually documented from repeated cross-sections. However, the time evolution of cross-sections is driven by workers’ flows across occupational categories and in and out of the labour market. Drawing on an administrative panel that follows French workers over 1984–2021, this column shows that polarisation emerged through a collapse in entry into routine jobs from non-employment, not through displacement of incumbent routine workers. The findings redirect policy attention from protecting existing jobs towards the entry margin.
abstract_zh: 就业极化——即中等技能常规职业相对于技能分布两端的衰退——通常通过重复截面数据加以记录。然而，截面的时间演变是由工人在职业类别间的流动以及进出劳动力市场的动态所驱动的。基于追踪法国工人1984年至2021年情况的行政面板数据，本专栏表明，极化现象源于非就业状态进入常规职业的通道崩溃，而非现有常规工人的被迫转移。研究结果将政策关注点从保护现有就业转向进入环节。
authors: Fabio Cerina, Elisa Dienesch, Alexander Monge-Naranjo, Alessio Moro
title: The anatomy of job polarisation: Evidence from four decades of French worker flows
title_zh: 工作两极化的解剖：来自法国工人流动四十年数据的证据
